# Slides Thief

> Browser-local web app and Python CLI that turn angled photos of slides or documents into perspective-corrected images and a clean PDF.

## Use and documentation

- Web app: https://slidesthief.com/
- Full agent reference: https://slidesthief.com/llms-full.txt
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/waittim/Slides-Thief
- CLI documentation: https://github.com/waittim/Slides-Thief/blob/main/docs/cli.md
- Output documentation: https://github.com/waittim/Slides-Thief/blob/main/docs/output-schema.md

## Machine-readable contracts

- Detection report schema: https://slidesthief.com/schemas/slide-lens-report.schema.json
- Manual corner schema: https://slidesthief.com/schemas/manual-quads.schema.json
- Citation metadata: https://slidesthief.com/citation.json
- Product metadata: https://slidesthief.com/product-metadata.json

## Discovery

Homepage HTML `<link>` tags advertise:

- `describedby` → `/llms.txt`
- `service-doc` → `/llms-full.txt`
- `sitemap` → `/sitemap.xml`

## Core facts

- Browser processing is local; source photos are not uploaded.
<!-- BEGIN GENERATED: llms-core-en -->
- Web formats: JPEG / JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC / HEIF. CLI formats: JPEG / JPG, PNG, TIFF, HEIC / HEIF.
- Web source formats: 16:9, 4:3, 16:10, A4, Letter, and custom ratios.
- Web PDF layouts: match the selected source format, physical A4, A3, Letter paper, or a custom page size.
<!-- END GENERATED: llms-core-en -->
- Web UI languages: zh-CN, zh-TW, en, es, fr, de, ja, ko, pt-BR.
- Corner order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
- License: MIT.
